title: Lindsey Grossman (ex-Stripe, Netflix, Intuit, Block, Wise) — 'a wakeup call for any founder who takes the advice of lawyers when setting up incorporation docs'
summary: Lindsey Grossman first met Eric at an Intuit innovation workshop he ran with Scott Cook, in the years when The Lean Startup was everywhere. She reads the new book as the correction to the thing that workshop left out: the incorporation paperwork founders sign without reading. She singles out the IKEA and Costco case studies and Anthropic's governance design.
blockquote: I’ve now just finished reading Eric Ries’s new book “Incorruptible”. I highly recommend it for founders and execs building a business and innovating in industries that need truly durable advantages. It is a wakeup call for any founder who takes the advice of lawyers when setting up incorporation docs and corporate structures without digging in to less common alternatives.
attribution_title: Product & GTM leader · ex-Stripe, Netflix, Intuit, Block, Wise
